description:
Lats Deck turns your iPad into a tactile cockpit for your Mac. Pair it with the Lattices menu bar app, then press, talk, swipe, and trigger focused actions without breaking your flow.

Start from Home to see paired Macs, active agents, recent activity, scenes, and routines at a glance. Enter the cockpit for a trackpad surface, live transcript, window map, system telemetry, and a row of controls tuned to the task at hand.

FIVE FOCUSED DECKS

• Command — capture, search, launch agents, and reach everyday actions
• Dev — open terminals, run builds and tests, work with Git, and inspect logs
• Windows — tile, center, move, and switch displays
• Media — control playback, volume, brightness, and screenshots
• Voice — dictate, issue voice commands, and follow the live transcript

BUILT FOR FLOW

• Swipe between decks without leaving the cockpit
• Use the large trackpad surface to control the paired Mac
• See window layouts and system status without looking away
• Undo supported actions from the replay surface
• Preview every deck before pairing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Lats Deck discovers the Lattices app over your local network. Pairing is explicitly approved on your Mac, protected with signed requests and encrypted payloads, and stored on your devices. No Lats account is required.

Requires the Lattices menu bar app on a compatible Mac. Visit lats.dev to get started.
promotionalText: Turn iPad into a tactile cockpit for your Mac. Press, talk, swipe, and trigger five focused decks over a private local connection.
